content.introduction: Today, NVIDIA stock reached a new all-time high following months of consolidation. The positive price action Friday and Monday are following OpenAI's release of GPT-5.5, NVIDIA's blogpost about GPT-5.5 in which they said OpenAI has committed to deploying 10 GW of NVIDIA systems, and Intel's positive earnings. Looking ahead, we have hyperscale earnings this Wednesday, April 29, 2026. Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft are all scheduled to report earnings on April 29, 2026. What these companies say about CapEx guidance and their AI strategies will have an important impact on NVIDIA stock moving forward. We are witnessing a major inflection in inference demand, and subsequently, an inflection in demand for NVIDIA's products. The sources don't provide a definitive answer.
